## DESCRIPTION
Briefly describe the change. Ensure it adheres to the **150-LOC limit**.

## TYPE OF CHANGE
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance

## ENGINEERING CHECKLIST
- [ ] **150-LOC Limit:** PR does not exceed 150 lines of code.
- [ ] **Strict TDD:** Red-Green-Refactor cycle followed. Failing tests attached/linked.
- [ ] **Complexity:** No function exceeds McCabe score of 10.
- [ ] **Result Pattern:** No exceptions used for control flow.
- [ ] **Documentation:** Wiki/Docs updated to reflect changes.
- [ ] **Conventional Commits:** PR title and commits follow the standard.

## VERIFICATION
Provide proof of verification (test results, complexity metrics, mutation scores).
